mapper.insert: insert into payment (order_id, pay_no, pay_type, amount, status, pay_time) values (#{orderId}, #{payNo}, #{payType}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{payTime})
mapper.update: update payment set pay_no = #{payNo}, pay_type = #{payType}, amount = #{amount}, status = #{status}, pay_time = #{payTime} where order_id = #{orderId} and status = 0
mapper.select: select max(pay_no) from payment where pay_no like concat(#{prefix}, '%')
mapper.update: update payment set status = 2 where order_id = #{orderId} and status = 1
